EAAccessory.doc: An object that contains information about a single, connected hardware accessory.

EAAccessoryManager.doc: The object you use to identify connected accessories, and begin delivery of connection and disconnection notifications.

EASession.doc: The object you use to manage communications between your app and a connected hardware accessory.

EAWiFiUnconfiguredAccessory.doc: An object that provides information about an unconfigured MFi Wireless Accessory Configuration accessory.

EAWiFiUnconfiguredAccessoryBrowser.doc: An object you use to scan for wireless accessories and configure them for use with the user’s app.

EAAccessoryDelegate.doc: A protocol that defines an optional method for receiving notifications when the associated accessory object is disconnected.

EAWiFiUnconfiguredAccessoryBrowserDelega.doc: A protocol you use to manage the search and configuration processes for an unconfigured accessory browser.

EABluetoothAccessoryPickerErrorCode.doc: The error codes that may be passed in an error object for the Bluetooth picker completion block.

EAWiFiUnconfiguredAccessoryBrowserState.doc: The possible states of an accessory browser.

EAWiFiUnconfiguredAccessoryBrowserStateC.doc: The browser is actively configuring an accessory.

EAWiFiUnconfiguredAccessoryBrowserStateS.doc: The browser is actively searching for unconfigured accessory.
The browser is not actively searching for unconfigured accessories.

EAWiFiUnconfiguredAccessoryBrowserStateW.doc: Wi-Fi is unavailable, typically because the user has placed the device in Airplane Mode or explicitly turned off Wi-Fi.

EAWiFiUnconfiguredAccessoryConfiguration.doc: Values that represent the state of the configuration process for an EAWiFiUnconfiguredAccessory object.
The configuration of the accessory succeeded.
The user cancelled the configuration process.

EAWiFiUnconfiguredAccessoryProperties.doc: Options that can be combined using the C bitwise OR operator to represent the properties of an unconfigured accessory.

EAWiFiUnconfiguredAccessoryPropertySuppo.doc: The accessory indicates that it supports AirPlay.
The accessory indicates that it supports AirPrint.
The accessory indicates that it supports HomeKit.

+sharedAccessoryManager.doc: Returns the shared accessory manager object for the iOS-based device.

-registerForLocalNotifications.doc: Begins the delivery of accessory-related notifications to the current application.

-showBluetoothAccessoryPickerWithNameFil.doc: Displays an alert that allows the user to pair the device with a Bluetooth accessory.

-unregisterForLocalNotifications.doc: Stops the delivery of accessory-related notifications to the current application.

-initWithAccessory:forProtocol:.doc: Initializes the session for the specified accessory and protocol.

-configureAccessory:withConfigurationUIO.doc: Begins the configuration process for the specified accessory.

-initWithDelegate:queue:.doc: Creates a browser object that scans for unconfigured accessories.

-startSearchingForUnconfiguredAccessorie.doc: Starts the search for unconfigured accessories that match the specified predicate.

-stopSearchingForUnconfiguredAccessories.doc: Stops the search for unconfigured accessories.

connected.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether the accessory is currently connected to the iOS-based device.

connectionID.doc: The accessory’s unique ID for connecting to the iOS-based device.

delegate.doc: The object that acts as the delegate of the accessory.

firmwareRevision.doc: The current firmware version for the accessory.

hardwareRevision.doc: The hardware version of the accessory.

manufacturer.doc: The name of the accessory’s manufacturer.

modelNumber.doc: The model information for the accessory.

name.doc: The display name of the accessory.

protocolStrings.doc: The communication protocols supported by the accessory.

serialNumber.doc: The serial number of the accessory.

connectedAccessories.doc: The accessory objects corresponding to the list of currently connected accessories.

accessory.doc: The accessory attached to the session.

inputStream.doc: The stream to use for receiving data from the accessory.

outputStream.doc: The stream to use for sending data to the accessory.

protocolString.doc: The protocol being used for communication with the accessory.

macAddress.doc: The primary MAC address of the accessory.

manufacturer.doc: The name of the accessory’s manufacturer.

ssid.doc: The Wi-Fi SSID of the accessory.

delegate.doc: The object that acts as the delegate of the browser and receives browser events.

unconfiguredAccessories.doc: The set of unconfigured accessories that have been discovered.
